validatedDiscovery.note: Discovery initially treated success exit codes accompanied by fatal Error diagnostics as accepted. Direct replay of the saved reproducers identified four contradictory reference results. Verification records these separately as inconsistent, with no language verdict.

replay: Copy the listed corpus files from test/pmars-clean-room into a separate directory and verify their hashes. For each run use node scripts/fuzz-pmars.js --pmars path/to/pmars --rules RULES --core CORE --length LENGTH --processes PROCESSES --cycles CYCLES --cases 1000 --seed SEED --corpus path/to/snapshot --out path/to/results, using the recorded settings. Minimum distance defaults to maximum length. --args on capture-pmars-probes.js accepts referenceArgs without the filename.
limitations: Empty programs are excluded as a deliberate runtime difference.
Crashes, timeouts, launch failures and contradictory reference results supply no language verdict.
One error-heavy reference listing varies across executions; captured bytes remain evidence, not a conformance target.
ICWS88 listings omit modifiers; comparisons cover opcodes, modes, fields and entry address.
This is assembly/preprocessing validation, not simulator validation or an exhaustive configuration matrix.
